paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 5.62 as of 2026-08-24, representing a decrease of 5.07% from the prior close and 22.27% over the last 21 trading sessions.

There have been no new news headlines in the last 24 hours, but recent news includes a report from Bloomberg.com on August 14, 2026, stating that Fermi received a US subpoena tied to Project Matador, and an article from The Lufkin Daily News on August 11, 2026, showing a conceptual rendering of the planned HyperGrid campus in Amarillo, Texas.

Recent SEC filings include a Form 4 filing on August 18, 2026, reporting an insider transaction, and a Form 10-Q filing on August 14, 2026, reporting a net loss for the second quarter of 2026, as well as the appointment of Lee McIntire as the new Chief Executive Officer, effective August 11, 2026, with an annualized base salary of $750,000.
